AnswerOut.description: Validated answer (no prompt, raw output or graph state).
AnswerOut.title: AnswerOut

ArticleCardV1.description: One current article (never a chunk); no full text.
ArticleCardV1.title: ArticleCardV1

ArticleDetailV1.description: Current revision; ``content`` is the normalized plain text when allowed.
ArticleDetailV1.title: ArticleDetailV1

ArticleFacetsV1.description: Facet counts; location counts include descendants (gazetteer rollup).
ArticleFacetsV1.title: ArticleFacetsV1

ArticleListV1.description: Keyset page; ``next_cursor`` is opaque and bound to filters + sort.
ArticleListV1.title: ArticleListV1

ArticleSummaryV1.description: Stored summary state; reading it never calls a model.
ArticleSummaryV1.title: ArticleSummaryV1

AuditMetadata.description: Versions and counts that make one answer reproducible (no content).
AuditMetadata.title: AuditMetadata

BriefingRequest.description: Strict public request; caller identity and policy are server-owned.
BriefingRequest.title: BriefingRequest

BriefingResponse.description: Public briefing answer; no prompt, raw output, graph state or lineage.
BriefingResponse.title: BriefingResponse

CitationOut.description: Persisted citation identity; open it through ``source_ref_url``.
CitationOut.title: CitationOut

CitedSpanOut.description: Cited span of the exact revision used.
CitedSpanOut.title: CitedSpanOut

ConversationOut.description: Conversation header with its frozen scope definition.
ConversationOut.title: ConversationOut

ErrorDetail.description: Stable error code plus an optional enum reason.
ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail

FacetCountV1.description: Distinct current articles with one label under all selected filters.
FacetCountV1.title: FacetCountV1

KeyPointV1.description: Key point with its supporting spans.
KeyPointV1.title: KeyPointV1

LabelProvenanceV1.description: Provenance of one label of the current revision.
LabelProvenanceV1.title: LabelProvenanceV1

LocationLabel.description: Location the article content is about (not the newsroom's location).
LocationLabel.title: LocationLabel

MessageOut.description: One message; assistant content is the validated answer text.
MessageOut.title: MessageOut

ProcessingStatus.description: Derived-data states of the current revision.
ProcessingStatus.title: ProcessingStatus

PublicCitation.description: Citation with an opaque source reference for the viewer.
PublicCitation.title: PublicCitation

PublicCitedSpan.description: Cited span of the revision the answer was grounded on.
PublicCitedSpan.title: PublicCitedSpan

RunAcceptedOut.description: 202 body of a submitted (or replayed) run.
RunAcceptedOut.title: RunAcceptedOut

RunErrorOut.description: Stable failure code of a failed run.
RunErrorOut.title: RunErrorOut

SessionOut.description: New session; the token is shown once.
SessionOut.title: SessionOut

SourceResponse.description: Authorized current source and cited span.
SourceResponse.title: SourceResponse

SourceV1.description: Publisher with its number of current articles.
SourceV1.title: SourceV1

SummaryGeneratorV1.description: Model/prompt/schema identity of a stored AI summary.
SummaryGeneratorV1.title: SummaryGeneratorV1

SupportingSpanV1.description: Code-point offsets into the NFC content of ``article_version_id``.
SupportingSpanV1.title: SupportingSpanV1

TemporalClaim.description: Known temporal value or explicit unknown, always evidence-backed.
TemporalClaim.title: TemporalClaim

VersionInfoV1.description: Version state of the served revision.
VersionInfoV1.title: VersionInfoV1
